out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The PIC could not locate a vomit and diarrhea clean up policy or kit.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS emailed the PIC a copy of the FCHD model vomit and diarrhea clean up policy which will be implemented. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. No paper towels were provided at the main hand sink in the food prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: Several items on the buffet were being held at room temperature without temperature control. They include sour cream at 72º, salsa at 70º, shredded cheese at 70º, whipped cream cheese at 70º, chia pudding at 76º, and overnight oats at 72º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The establishment does not have a time as a public health control policy, but does discard these items at the end of the 3 hour serving period. The PIC will discard these items in 30 minutes. The PIC requested to create a time as a public health policy. One was created during the inspection and entered into the establishment record. CDI.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. The PIC could not locate a food temperature thermometer.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Provide a food temperature measuring device as soon as possible or within 10 days. A follow-up is required for this violation.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed that clean paper plates and bowls were stored in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination. The bowls and plates were not stored inverted as required at the buffet line.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean single-service and single-use articles in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor, unless kept in closed packages on pallets, racks, or skids. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed a case of paper cups stored on the floor in the storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Discontinue storing paper and styrofoam products on the floor. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. The PIC could not locate the quaternary ammonia test kit.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a quaternary ammonia test kit as soon as possible or within 10 days. A follow-up inspection is required for this.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the heat sanitizing dish machine piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.
